blocks.title: Ask this page
blocks.description: A question box that answers from the page's own content, with follow-ups.

blocks.title: Explain selection
blocks.description: Select any text on the page and an "Explain" button appears next to it.

blocks.title: Summarize this page
blocks.description: Three buttons, three lengths, the answer streams in.

blocks.title: Translate this page
blocks.description: Pick a language and the main content is rewritten in it; click again to restore.

blocks.title: FAQ bot
blocks.description: Answers only from the FAQ you wrote; says "I don't know" for anything else.

blocks.title: Draft a reply
blocks.description: Paste an email, review or ticket, pick a tone, get a reply you can edit.

blocks.title: Rewrite
blocks.description: Make any text shorter, longer, formal or friendly, in place.

blocks.title: Extract to JSON
blocks.description: Paste messy text, get structured fields back as an object.

blocks.title: Smart search
blocks.description: Describe what you want in plain words and the matching items light up.

blocks.title: Describe an image
blocks.description: Alt text for any photo, from a file or any on the page.

blocks.title: Explain code
blocks.description: An Explain button on every code block on the page.

blocks.title: Quiz from this page
blocks.description: Three multiple-choice questions generated from the page content.
